patches.old: Premise addressed: Capability gains will be gradual and visible. Earliest SL4 passage that names and rejects a slow-takeoff scenario. The target is a futurist model of a receding event horizon; the paragraph does not discuss whether slowness would give time to adjust. His accompanying prediction of a hard takeoff 'in the next ten years or so' (next paragraph) did not come true. The immediate topic is predictability (the "moving Event Horizon"). The same message predicts a hard takeoff "sometime in the next ten years or so" (from 2001), which did not happen.
